title: Quantization profile regression pipeline for FP8/INT8
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build an automated regression pipeline to validate FP8 and INT8 quantization profiles against golden prompt sets and production-like prompt distributions. The pipeline must run nightly and on PRs for quant-profile changes, produce pass/fail gates using configurable thresholds, and emit detailed diagnostics (per-token KL, embedding cosine delta, exact-match delta, and percentile latency). This work covers: (1) assembling and curating a golden prompt bank stratified by bucket (completion, instruction, multi-turn chat, code), (2) integrating calibration sweeps and per-layer scale map capture, (3) defining multi-metric gates and dynamic tolerances, (4) hooking results into Console rollouts and alerts so that failed regressions can block a quant-profile promotion, and (5) storing result artifacts for offline analysis and audit. Total scope includes CI integration, dashboarding, alerting, and documentation for SRE/ModelOps to act on failures.
acceptance_criteria: Nightly run executes over full golden bank and produces a JSON artifact with metrics (embedding_cosine_mean, embedding_cosine_p5, token_kl_mean, exact_match_rate, rouge-L, latency_p95)
PR job runs for quant-profile changes and marks status checks 'passed' or 'failed' based on configured gates
Console shows a per-profile historical trend and flags regressions with diffs and sample inputs/outputs
If a profile fails a gate, rollout promotion is blocked and a PagerDuty playbook link is surfaced
Calibration metadata (per-layer scale maps and percentile thresholds) are persisted alongside artifacts for reproducibility
tasks: Curate golden prompt bank (selectors, anonymization, sampling by traffic) - deliver CSV and JSONL
Implement calibration sweep runner that records per-layer activation statistics and recommended clipping percentiles
Develop metric computation library (embedding similarity, token KL, exact-match, BLEU/ROUGE variants) with stable seeds
Create CI job templates for PR and nightly runs; wire to GitHub Actions/Buildkite
Build Console dashboard widgets and regression alerting integration
Write runbook for triage and rollback (link to playbook)

notes: Design trade-offs: We avoid a single monolithic threshold. Instead, create a weighted gate combining embedding delta and task-specific metrics (e.g., exact-match for QA, rouge-L for summarization).
Calibration approach: use percentile-based activation clipping (default p99.9), then per-layer scale quantization with optional per-channel affine for INT8 where supported.
Performance: Nightly run targets 3-hour max end-to-end for full bank on dedicated test fleet; PR runs use a sampled subset (~200 prompts) to keep latency <15 minutes.
Rollout integration: If a profile fails, the pipeline will create a failed rollout snapshot in Console and assign to ModelOps team with a priority tag.
